name: Clinical Trial
tagline: Clinical study protocol: white-grey layout, a single blue accent, phase label and participant table.
best: clinical study, patient information, research protocol
signature: **Single blue accent:** confirmation and links only.
must: Protocol number and version in every section.
Participant counts are tabular.
Consent and warning text never falls below 14px.
essence: Clinical Trial makes a protocol readable on screen: phase, number, participants and endpoint.
brief: Design a clinical study page: white-grey layout, mono phase label, protocol table, a single blue accent.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 26ch; }
.pg-table td { font-size: 12.5px; }

name: Lab Protocol
tagline: Laboratory protocol: numbered steps, monospace timestamps and a warning block.
best: laboratory protocol, experiment log, instrument procedure
signature: **Warning block:** 2px accent on the left, --surface-2 background.
must: Duration and instrument in every step.
Warnings sit inside the step, not in a separate section.
Units are mono.
mustNot: More than ten steps on one screen.
essence: Lab Protocol visualises repeatability: every step is numbered, timed and flagged.
brief: Design a laboratory protocol: dark background, numbered steps, mono timestamps, warning block with a left accent rule.
extraCss:
h1 { font-size: var(--type-h1); max-width: 26ch; }
.pg-card { border-left: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 44%, var(--line)); }

name: Pharmacy Labels
tagline: Medication label legibility: high contrast, large type, dosage table and an unmistakable warning band.
best: medication instructions, dosage schedule, patient education
signature: **Large type:** 17px body, 24px dosage; type size is never reduced.
must: Dosage and frequency never fall below 17px.
The warning band uses both text and an icon.
Line length stays at 60ch for legibility.
mustNot: Legal text set in small type.
essence: Pharmacy Labels makes legibility the only measure: large type, high contrast, clear warnings.
brief: Design a medication instructions page: white background, 17px body, mono dosage table, red warning band.

name: Physiotherapy

best: physiotherapy/rehabilitation, exercise plan, follow-up
avoid: a dark technical panel, an aggressive competition screen
signature: **Exercise card:** name, set × rep, duration; 12px corners.
**Soft language:** rounded corners, a single shadow.
must: Her egzersizde set, tekrar ve dinlenme.
Pain scale 0–10 stated in text.
Touch target ≥ 48px.

brief: Design a physiotherapy exercise plan: soft green, exercise cards, mono set/rep table, progress bar.

name: Mental Wellness

**Lilac accent:** the selected mood and the CTA only.
